scope: Supported app/worker driver composition and source review, not a generic duplicate-SQLite detector or untrusted-plugin security boundary.
workerModuleSelection: Parent resolves its own better-sqlite3 package module and supplies that trusted module path to the worker; database metadata does not select a SQLite core.
formatInspection: Existing writable targets are inspected through another connection to the same imported NativeDatabase; readDatabaseFormat uses SQL PRAGMAs and metadata. Namespace checks use lstat, not raw descriptor open/read/close on a live database.
modelOwnerScope: Persistent .native-model-owner.lock serializes native model/maintenance services, not arbitrary bindings or all foreground connections.
unsupportedTopology: Independent SQLite library binaries must not open the same file in one process. Raw external reads/open-close of a live SQLite file must not bypass SQLite bookkeeping. Independent SQL tooling should use a separate process and matching locking/filesystem assumptions.
futureSupport: If arbitrary duplicate-driver/plugin access becomes a requirement, first add and fault-qualify a real process-wide coordination/refusal design. The current inventory is observation, not enforcement against arbitrary additional native modules.
